---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,project-management/**/*.md,README.md"
---
# Documentation instructions
- Check for an existing authoritative source before creating a new document.
- Mark material findings Verified, Inferred, or Unknown and include source paths where practical.
- Include the date and scope for major audits.
- Never include credentials, tokens, private keys, or production records.
- Keep feature status aligned with code and tests, not merely planned descriptions.
- Update affected docs and task state when behavior changes.
